messages:
Jess (Sales): Hey team — FinLedger POC asking for EU-only processing (no non-EU subprocessors in the data path) and a 99.95% region-availability SLA for the EU tenant during the POC. Need feasibility + a rough uplift for pricing call tomorrow. Customer expects ~200 rps peak, KYC data. Can SE/ops confirm feasibility?

Arun (SE): We can support tenant pinning to an EU region via Dedicated capacity. A few clarifying Qs: do they require BYOK (customer-managed KMS)? Any strict egress or IP whitelisting requirements? Are they OK with EU cloud providers (GCP/Azure in EU) as subprocessors?

Jess (Sales): They require BYOK and explicitly ask that no subprocessor outside the EU is involved in processing or storage. Egress to the customer's endpoint from EU-only is fine. They also want a subprocessor attestation.

Maya (Product): Short answer: doable, with caveats. We have an EU-only Dedicated configuration but an absolute "no third-party subprocessors outside EU" guarantee is tough — we can provide an attestation and lock routing to EU regions. For HA we normally run hot-standby in a second EU region (eg eu-west-1 <-> eu-west-3). That adds cost and a longer delivery timeline (~2-3 weeks to provision + KMS onboarding).

Sam (Infra): Ops notes — tenant pinning + BYOK requires KMS setup, peering, and cert provisioning. Timeline: once order and KMS keys are provided, network and certs take ~5 business days; full end-to-end POC with hot-standby and replication ~10-15 business days. Hot-standby doubles a subset of capacity (KV cache replication + duplicate GPU warm pools) so expect extra resource overhead.

Arun (SE): Pricing rough ballpark for presales call: base Dedicated commit + BYOK/HSM uplift ~+40% monthly. Hot-standby (cross-region) add ~+25% on top. For a small-medium POC approximating 200 rps we might quote "approx +50-70% uplift vs standard hosted" as a conservative customer-facing number until finance confirms. I'll follow up with precise instance counts.

Legal Bot: We can provide a Subprocessor Attestation and an EU-focused DPA amendment. Note: we cannot remove certain operational subprocessors entirely (eg observability vendors) but we can provide attestations and contractual guarantees limiting data access and location. Ops will supply subprocessors list and region mappings.

Sam (Infra): Action items I'm taking: open infra ticket INFRA-12234 for the onboarding flow (KMS + peering + certs). Will add a checklist for EU-only routing and replication. ETA for getting an environment ready (assuming paperwork signed and BYOK keys provided): ~10 business days. Cost uplift calc needs finance input — I'll request an internal estimate.

Jess (Sales): Great. I'll tell the customer: (1) we can do EU-only processing with attestation, (2) BYOK required and onboarding needed, (3) hot-standby is available but increases cost and lead time. Also requesting the customer's security questionnaire and any required vendor forms.

Maya (Product): I'll draft a short presales checklist and link it here: https://redwood.example.com/docs/presales/eu-dedicated-checklist. Also adding an internal config snippet for SEs: \n```\nregion_pin=eu-only\nfailover=hot-standby-eu\nkms_mode=customer_managed\n```\n
Arun (SE): For the call, useful one-liner to the customer: "We can provide EU-only Dedicated with customer-managed KMS and a Subprocessor Attestation; HA across EU regions is supported at an additional cost and a ~2–3 week setup window."

Jess (Sales): Can ops attach a draft cost estimate by EOD so I can present to procurement? Also please include the subprocessors list link. :thumbsup: 

Sam (Infra): I'll try to get a preliminary estimate (range) today but final pricing needs finance sign-off. If we cannot meet the absolute NO-NON-EU requirement, fallback is: strict EU routing + attestations + contractual restrictions. I'll attach subprocessors list link to the infra ticket when available.

Jess (Sales): Thanks everyone — I'll update FinLedger and push for their security forms. Will ping again after ops/finance update.
